Visibility Analysis of Wind Turbines

Spring 2020University of Eastern FinlandAdvanced GIS coursework

The challenge

A wind power company needed to evaluate the visual impact of proposed turbines across three sites in the Joensuu and Kontiolahti area: Ilvesvaara, Mustavaara and Kolvananvaara. The task was to map exactly which surface locations would have line-of-sight to the turbine tops, critical information for environmental impact assessment.

Viewshed computed from a DEM with observer points at each proposed turbine apex (160 m hub-to-tip). Shaded cells are open land with direct line of sight. Forest-screened ground is excluded, so these areas are smaller than the raw viewshed. Grid 16 m, ETRS-TM35FIN.

Loading map…

The approach

Viewshed analysis was performed in ArcGIS Pro using Digital Elevation Model data for each of the three sites. Observer points were placed at each proposed turbine location, and visibility surfaces were generated showing areas from which the turbine apex would be visible. Results were presented as three separate maps suitable for inclusion in a planning report.

Key outcomes

  • Viewshed maps produced for all three proposed turbine sites
  • Terrain obstruction accounted for using high-resolution DEM data
  • Outputs formatted as planning-ready maps for environmental impact submissions
